newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice rallies to new highs on slow cash sales.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice rallies to new highs on slow cash sales.

text.p: Slow producer and reseller movement of cash rice allowed early commercial buying and late fund demand to boost CBOT rice futures to a higher close and new contract highs, traders said.
"The overnight cash trade supported the market. They lifted some hedges, the commercials supported it," a trader said.
"The market continues to be bid up to keep the supply coming into the market," he said.
The new high for January rice is $11.39 per cwt, up from the previous high of $11.33 which was set Monday.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, above the 242 traded Monday.
Rice closed 7-1/2 to 11 cents per cwt higher, with January up 7-1/2 at $11.39 per cwt.
